description: Rapid Flood Inundation Mapping for Catastrophic Floods Due to Dam Failures - CUAHSI Summer Institute 2024 is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Nemnem, Ayman (deposited on HydroShare). This data repository is connected with the CUAHSI Summer Institute 2024 program, SHARP FIM group. The data includes flood inundation maps developed using three models (HEC-RAS, OWP HAND-FIM, FLDPLN) for two dam break model scenarios of the Fall River Lake dam, Kansas. Coverage: Kansas, United States. The resource was created 2024-07-22 and last updated 2026-02-03; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
